[USER] User has never tried putting nuts or seeds in noodle dishes before.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Provided two noodle recipes that incorporate nuts and seeds:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 1. Peanut Sesame Noodles:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Cook preferred noodles, whisk together 2 tbsp peanut butter, 2 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp rice vinegar, 1 tbsp sesame oil, and 1 tbsp honey (optional).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Toss cooked noodles with sauce, add sliced bell peppers, chopped scallions, and peanuts.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Serve and garnish with sesame seeds.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 2. Almond Ginger Noodles:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Cook preferred noodles, sauté sliced garlic and diced ginger in 1 tbsp canola oil until fragrant.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Add cooked noodles, sliced bell peppers, and sliced carrots, cook for a few minutes.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Turn off heat, add sliced almonds, 1 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tsp brown sugar, and a pinch of red pepper flakes.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Toss and serve with sesame seeds on top.
